|ingredients = {{Name|Sweet Gem Berry|1}} }} The '''White Turban''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be [[Tailoring#Hats|tailored]] using [[Cloth]] and a [[Sweet Gem Berry]] at the sewing machine inside [[2 Willow Lane|Emily's house]] or the [[Sewing Machine]] received as a reward for the [[Quests#Rock Rejuvenation|"Rock Rejuvenation"]] special order. It can also be obtained from [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the [[Skull Cavern]] (≈3.85% chance). The hat can rarely be found in [[the Mines]] as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item]], from special monster drops or crates and barrels, during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|'Danger In The Deep']] quest or after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]]. ==References== See Locations::MineShaft::getTreasureRoomItem in the game code.
